expanded_ceilings.implemented: Exact backtracking supports anchored/unanchored nodes, multiple reciprocal bonds, state, compartment, free-site, and bound-site constraints.
expanded_ceilings.remaining: Native symmetric automorphisms, negative/molecularity forms, and unbounded connectedTo remain fail-closed.

expanded_ceilings.implemented: Parsed arithmetic/conditional expressions resolve named matched-state and finite-constant bindings plus time and built-ins.

expanded_ceilings.implemented: Known parent-linked compartments support ancestry predicates and MoveConnected relocates a validated connected species atomically.

remaining_fallback_details: Native symmetric/internal graph automorphisms, negative expressions, molecularity constraints, and unbounded connectedTo remain fail-closed.
Native LocalFunction/DOR object scopes, observables, function DAGs, TFUN counters, and complete DOR2 composition remain compatibility fallbacks.
Compartment volume/region scaling, dimension conversion, and topology-changing transport remain fail-closed.
Native conditional-deletion spellings whose component ownership or post-delete invalidation cannot be established remain fail-closed.
Independent seeded trajectory, propensity, and failure-classification parity against NFsim/BNG2/Rasi/uORF oracles is not claimed.
